study.question: At fixed native width and matched persistent capacity, does replacing the retained prefix coordinates by suffix coordinates preserve the near-source click-quality/cost result? Is width14 versus width15 behavior robust to this prescribed replacement, or specific to the previously selected initialization subspace?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: all promising coupled reductions retained the first item coordinates of one untrained full16 initialization. Source click AUC is0.660646940486458 at32060453 parameters. Prefix15 reached0.6605886110435017 at30536464 parameters (4.7535% fewer), p50/p95 9.6487/9.7238ms versus11.6574/11.7209ms for the latest source control; loader-inclusive23.9180s versus23.9937s establishes no large end-to-end saving. Prefix14 reached0.660482133621223 at29012475 parameters (9.5070% fewer), p50/p95 9.1347/9.1885ms. Native15/native14 were0.6587118957609871/0.6577577448639634 at the same widths. Thus scratch initialization is consequential. The provisional capacity-redundancy explanation predicts that another prescribed retained coordinate set can also keep click AUC close at the same cost; the competing explanation is favorable prefix-specific optimization. Both are local hypotheses, not established mechanisms. DIN click AUC0.6555440824200336 and mean-task AUC0.8099233880793816; source mean-task AUC0.6757994144720098 already documents a substantial auxiliary-quality tradeoff. Earlier uniform embedding/dense halving, projection/frozen-map and field-allocation branches failed to retain source click AUC; coupled8 (0.6599120831369636) outperformed coupled12 (0.6581366143021284), arguing against a smooth width-only interpretation. No execution failures are recorded in the supplied trajectory index; previous_runtime_error is null. Missing torch/data access in this phase is a prerequisite limitation, distinct from those measured negative results.

study.proposed_difference: A 2x2 factorial: item width14/15 crossed with retained prefix/suffix coordinates. Prefix15 uses0..14 and suffix15 uses1..15; prefix14 uses0..13 and suffix14 uses2..15, identically for every item field. Context/action remain all16. Copy matching semantic columns in every query/key/difference/product block and both target/pooled tower blocks, while copying all shared hidden weights/buffers unchanged. Coordinate selection occurs only during scratch initialization and adds no persistent parameter or forward work. Prefix cells replay previously measured operators; suffix cells are new candidates. Within a width, this is a capacity- and computation-matched initialization replacement, not a change in information availability. Width-by-selection interactions are measured rather than pooled away.
predictions: Implementation prediction: each width15 cell has total/embedding/dense counts30536464/30276907/259557; each width14 cell29012475/28760598/251877. Prefix and suffix have identical state shapes and inference call structure. Host must measure; scratch construction cost is additional and reported.

Compatibility prediction: prefix15 reproduces g1-r0017-coupled_item15_action16 and prefix14 reproduces g1-r0016-coupled_item14_action16 under the frozen seed and execution. Endpoint checks test reproducibility, not independent support.

Capacity explanation predicts suffix15 also lies close to source. For future cells, a provisional screening margin is click AUC loss<=0.0001 to the unchanged source; this margin is newly chosen after inspecting historical results, is not a retrospective equivalence test, and does not establish statistical noninferiority. Report continuous deltas for all cells regardless of the screen.

Suffix14 distinguishes a coordinate-sensitive recovery from the prior prefix14 AUC loss0.000164806865235. Report selection effect at each width and interaction D=(AUC_suffix14-AUC_prefix14)-(AUC_suffix15-AUC_prefix15), with no significance claim from one seed.

At a fixed width, no intrinsic speed difference is predicted between selection modes. A quality/cost screen additionally requires fewer parameters and >=10% lower model p50 and p95 than source, without >5% loader-inclusive wall-time regression under comparable host measurements; numerical thresholds are decision aids, not evidence of repeatability or production speedup. Source latency reference uses g1-r0017-coupled_item16_action16_control and must be remeasured if hardware/measurement conditions changed.
falsifiers: If prefix controls or full16 state/RNG/output compatibility fail, the proposed implementation is invalid; do not treat its resulting AUC as evidence against the mechanism.

If suffix15 loses>0.0001 AUC to source while prefix15 reproduces its near-source result, the tested coordinate-replacement robustness prediction fails. Consistent deficits of both widths across replacement sets contradict the proposed retention benefit in this range.

A large selection effect relative to the small width effect, or a large interaction D, prevents attributing the existing result to width alone. Conversely no observed selection effect under this one overlapping replacement only weakly supports robustness.

If measured model latency does not improve, or loader-inclusive cost materially regresses, parameter reduction alone does not establish the task efficiency objective. AUC gains accompanied by worse auxiliary metrics remain an explicit multi-task tradeoff.
alternative_explanations: One fixed seed and one temporal validation population; same-seed replays are not repetitions.
Prefix/suffix selections overlap heavily and share all hidden/context/action initialization; this is a narrow coordinate-replacement contrast, not independent seeds or general coordinate invariance.

The intervention jointly replaces retained item-table coordinates and their semantically corresponding scorer/tower columns; it does not isolate which of these initialization components causes a difference.
Single-pass optimization, Dice batch statistics and BF16 numerical trajectories may mediate differences; no claim of intrinsic minimal representation dimension.
Measured GPU latency is shape/hardware dependent and loader-inclusive wall time may be dominated by other costs.

Historical width15 was selected after many trials; validation selection bias remains. Native initialization differences may reflect changed random streams/fan-in rather than any intrinsic capacity requirement.

In the latest knowledge-usage record, DIN usage was declared and executed; near-source widths produced local performance observations but did not confirm a new mechanism. paper:hemix remained metadata-only/unresolved there and supplies no adopted mechanism or verified difference in this study.
Suffix failure does not refute every capacity-reduction strategy; suffix success does not establish redundancy of arbitrary coordinates or robust retention across seeds.

knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: Keep the adapted DIN-derived source operator fixed; implement a data-independent prefix/suffix replacement of copied initialization coordinates at matched native width. No new DIN training technique or regularizer adopted.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: Local source-initialization attribution in an existing four-task compressed architecture; no new architecture, exact reproduction or priority claim. Broader compression nearest work is unverified after authorized searches returned no closer source.
